All batch behaviour and all safety policy are defined in .claude/skills/batch-skill/SKILL.md, which is the SSOT. maxParallelTasks is a ceiling, not a licence: it can only lower concurrency, never authorise parallelism that the CONFIRMED-only evidence bar has not already permitted.
